bb.tok_emb.desc: input embeddings (text rows: embed_tokens; image rows are replaced by the merger output)

bb.visual_tokens.desc: vision merger output = the 64 visual tokens per view [192, 2048]

vit.patch.desc: patch_embed output, head view (256 patches of 16px, merge-window order)

vit.block_norm.desc: per-patch residual norm after each of the 24 vision blocks

lm.token_norm.desc: per-token residual norm into each LM layer; last row = backbone output

lm.out.desc: backbone output = hidden_states[-1] (after the final RMSNorm)

lm.L0.attn.desc: LM layer 0 causal attention, mean over 16 heads [S, S]

lm.L15.attn.desc: LM layer 15 causal attention, mean over 16 heads [S, S]

vlln.desc: vlln LayerNorm(2048) of the backbone output

vlsa.B0.out.desc: vl_self_attention block 0 output (block 3 = the DiT's K/V source)

vlsa.B1.out.desc: vl_self_attention block 1 output (block 3 = the DiT's K/V source)

vlsa.B2.out.desc: vl_self_attention block 2 output (block 3 = the DiT's K/V source)

vlsa.B3.out.desc: vl_self_attention block 3 output (block 3 = the DiT's K/V source)

vl.token_norm.desc: per-token norm of the VL tokens the DiT reads

vl.image.desc: VL tokens where image_mask = 1 [192, 2048]: K/V of the image cross blocks (b % 4 == 2)

vl.text.desc: VL tokens where image_mask = 0 [24, 2048]: K/V of the text cross blocks (b % 4 == 0)

s0.sa_in.desc: DiT input sequence = [state token | 40 action tokens] [41, 1536]

s0.D0.k.desc: K head 0 (cross: from the VL tokens; self: from sa)

s0.D1.k.desc: K head 0 (cross: from the VL tokens; self: from sa)

sample.task: Turn on the radio receiver that's on the table in the living room.
sample.language: turn on the radio receiver thats on the table in the living room

notes: weights + activations are real: local GR00T-N1.7-3B safetensors, BEHAVIOR 2026-challenge-demos frame
backbone config/processor: local Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct (Cosmos-Reason2-2B is not local; same architecture, shapes match exactly); weights are GR00T's own backbone.* tensors
embodiment slot 23 (sim_behavior_r1_pro) is untrained (per-slot std = init 0.02): the state/action adapters are real-but-untrained weights -> toy; the decoded actions carry no meaning
state = BEHAVIOR 61-dim proprio (q01/q99 -> [-1,1]); the sim template's world-pose keys are absent from the 2026 demos, so the 61 dims fill slots 0..60 and 61..131 are zero
compute in float32 from bf16 weights (official runtime: bf16)
noise seed 0; Euler integrates upward t = 0, .25, .5, .75 (t=0 is noise)
